Order No.10 Date: 06.12.2024
1.

The petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Daltonganj Mahila P.S. Case No.37 of 2022 registered under Sections 498A/313/323/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, has prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
2. It is jointly submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner and the opposite party no.2 that the mediation proceeding between the said parties at JHALSA, Ranchi has been successful.

The terms of settlement/memo of agreement dated 30th August, 2024 has been appended with letter no.2481A,

1 dated 31st August, 2024 issued by the Mediator, JHALSA, Ranchi to the Assistant Registrar-XXIV of this Court.
3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in terms with the memo of agreement dated 30th August, 2024, the demand draft of Rs.2,00,000/- drawn in favour of the opposite party no.2 is being handed to learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 in the Court itself.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 accepts the said demand draft.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 further submit that both the parties shall duly comply the terms of memo of agreement dated 30th August,
2024.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that the petitioner and the opposite party no.2 have amicably settled the present dispute in terms with the memo of agreement dated 30th August, 2024 during the mediation proceeding conducted at JHALSA, Ranchi, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail.

7. Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the court below within three weeks from today, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau at Daltonganj in connection with Daltonganj Mahila P.S. Case No.37 of 2022 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Vikas/
